newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hongkong Land touches new high.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Land touches new high.

text.p: Hongkong Land Holdings Ltd rallied to a new 1997 high of US$3.44 in early trade on Wednesday.
At 0124 GMT, the stock was at US$3.38, up 26 cents. Volume was an active 11.6 million units.
"Everybody is just watching the counter. There isn't very much fundamental going on now, it is just momentum buying," a broker with Singapore firm said.
She said punters were also leaping in to Robert Fleming Hongkong Land covered warrants, which expire at the end of this year, pushing them up 29 percent or US$0.155 cents to US$0.665.
Other Jardine units were also active with Jardine Matheson up 30 cents to US$8.15, and Jardine Strategic touching a new 1997 high of US$4.30, up 18 cents.
The buying in the Jardine group was sparked by news Hong Kong tycoon Li Ka Shing's Cheung Kong and Hutchison Whampoa have bought just over three percent of Hongkong Land and also Jardine Matheson.
